name: Mythomania Magical Girls
source:
Mankind's utopia promises every young girl the chance to harness magic for the benefit of all. "Every young girl will graduate." "Magic is yours to command." "We'll all smile at your graduation."

"But any girl who tells lies in the eyes of Beed will be punished by cracking."

Iris, a promising young student of prodigious talent, will soon graduate and lay claim her own magic.

Deborah, her best friend and an expert in magical exploitation, watches over her with high expectations.

The two will discover that in a world that rejects all lies, broken promises and withheld emotions sting even more deeply. 

[From [url=https://aimvtuber.itch.io/mythomania-magical-girls]itch.io[/url]]
